description: Baseline metric thresholds for the 25-case smoke eval (propose/confirm booking architecture; typed search_rooms tool, returning 4 rooms by default and up to 15 on request via its limit argument). Two cases are attribute searches: case_0207 (room type, floor, and view, then the cheapest of the matches) and case_0220 (ocean-view suites, then a price cap on the same search). strict=true metrics require every individual case score to equal 1.0; strict=false metrics require the mean across cases to be >= min_allowed. Judge and Ragas LLM is gemini-3.5-flash-lite (gemini-2.5-flash was deprecated for this account); booking.llm.reasoning_effort is medium. Ragas context precision uses the hotel-tuned prompt in eval/evaluators/_rag_prompts.py, which scores a chunk as useful when it answers any one clause of a multi-part question, and skips turns whose reference is only the 'nothing matched' sentinel ([ragas].no_match_reference). Ragas calls retry transient Gemini errors, and a failed call is never scored as 0.0, so a 0.0 in the per-turn detail is a real score. booking_expected_search_pass_rate is averaged over the two labeled cases, whose three labeled turns all passed; min_allowed 0.75 tolerates one missed turn in case_0220 but fails if case_0207's only labeled turn misses. min_allowed for rag_context_precision_mean and rag_faithfulness_mean matches the full-eval baseline (0.80 / 0.85); at n=18 scored turns this leaves less headroom than the full set, so watch this one first if a run trips it.
